name: monthly_surplus
description: Works out how much money is left each month after regular spending, which is the amount available to save for the wedding.
formula: monthly surplus = net_monthly_income - the sum of the amounts in monthly_spending (an empty list counts as zero). The result is negative if spending is higher than income.

inputs.name: net_monthly_income
inputs.description: Your take-home pay for one month, after taxes and deductions, in your currency.

inputs.name: monthly_spending
inputs.description: Your regular monthly costs, one item for each, excluding the wedding payments. Each item has name (text) and amount (money in your currency, per month). If you only know one overall figure, give a single item with that amount. May be an empty list if there is none.

output.description: Monthly surplus in your currency: net monthly income minus all monthly spending. It can be negative if you spend more than you earn.
